title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
summary: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion is a pixel-art beat 'em up from Tribute Games, published by Dotemu, released on Switch 2 on December 1, 2025. It has 15 playable heroes, including Spider-Man, Wolverine and Silver Surfer. At 735 MB it is one of the smallest Switch 2 games we track, so storage is no concern, and the physical release is a full cartridge that plays without a download. Up to four players can team up on one system or online, and the eShop lists cross-platform play.
